about.title: About CarParts Kurdistan
about.p1: CarParts Kurdistan connects drivers across Kurdistan with hard-to-find car parts. Tell us your car and the part you need — we source it, usually from China or Dubai, and send you a price before anything is charged.
about.p2: We don't stock parts on a shelf. Every request is sourced individually, so we can cover any brand, model, or year — not just what happens to be in stock.
about.p3: You approve the price, choose how to pay, and track your order until it arrives.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: The fastest way to reach us is to submit a part request from your account — our team reviews it and sends you a quote. WhatsApp and social channels are on their way; for now, questions about an existing order are best handled from My Requests once you're logged in.

items.a: Prices aren't fixed in advance — we source parts individually. Submit a request with your car and part, and we'll send you a price to review. Nothing is charged until you approve it. Some parts show a typical price range on the request form so you have a rough idea before you submit.
Mainly China and Dubai, depending on what's available and how quickly you need it. We'll tell you the source when we send your quote.
It depends on the part and where it's sourced from — we'll keep you updated at every stage, from ordering to arrival in Kurdistan.
Once you approve a quote, choose cash on delivery, bank transfer, or online payment. You'll see exactly how to complete each option in your account.

items.q: What if I don't know my car's paint color code?
items.a: For painted parts, we'll ask for a color code — you can usually find it on a sticker in the driver's door jamb, or in your registration papers. We show a helper with more detail when it's needed.
Yes — once your order is paid, its status updates as it moves from sourcing to shipped to arrived to ready for pickup or delivery, all visible in My Requests.

sections.b: CarParts Kurdistan is a quote-request platform, not a live catalog with fixed prices. Submitting a request does not create a binding order — an order is only confirmed once you approve a quote and complete payment.
Prices are sourced individually per request and may change based on availability. If a quote is no longer valid, we'll ask you to request an updated price.
You choose a payment method after approving a quote. For bank transfers, we may ask for proof of payment before confirming your order.
You may reject a quote at any time before payment at no charge. Once payment is confirmed, cancellations are handled case by case — contact us as soon as possible.
We do our best to source the correct part based on the details you provide. Please double-check your vehicle and part details before submitting, especially color codes for painted parts.
These terms may be updated from time to time. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the update.
Your name, phone number and/or email, the vehicle and part details you submit, any photos you attach, and your order and payment-method history.
To process your part requests, send you quotes and status updates, and contact you about your orders — in-app, and via WhatsApp where available.
We don't store full payment card details. Bank transfer proof images are used only to confirm your payment.
We don't sell your information. We only share what's needed with our sourcing partners to fulfill your request.
You can ask us to review, correct, or delete your account information at any time.
This policy may be updated from time to time. We'll keep the latest version here.
